functionality: Finance Dashboard Summary, Billing Summary, Collection Summary
description: One consolidated read endpoint over dashboard_cache (per instruction to prefer one endpoint over several closely-related ones). Billing Summary and Collection Summary are two more dashboard_key values of the same generic cache row shape, not separate tables.

validation: key must be one of FINANCE_SUMMARY, BILLING_SUMMARY, COLLECTION_SUMMARY
reads the most recent dashboard_cache row for (organization_id, branch_id, dashboard_key = key)

errors.condition: key missing or not a recognized value
no cached dashboard value exists yet for this key
organizationId or branchId does not exist

notes: dashboard_cache.dashboard_value is a precomputed JSONB blob; this contract documents the read side only. Population of dashboard_cache rows for BILLING_SUMMARY/COLLECTION_SUMMARY from billing_master/payment (e.g. via a scheduled job) is an implementation detail outside this contract's scope - billing_master and payment are listed above as the real source tables so no new table is implied.
